high_level_overview.overview: This JCL job, named **READCARD**, is designed to read and process a Card Master VSAM file as part of the CardDemo application. It executes the program **CBACT02C**, which accesses a Key-Sequenced Data Set (KSDS) containing credit card data stored in **AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS**. The job's business purpose is to retrieve and process card account records, with all output and print results directed to the system output for review or further processing.

parameters.name: JOB
parameters.description: The job name identifier assigned to this job, used to identify the job in the system and in job logs.

parameters.name: CLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the job class (input queue) to which the job is submitted, determining scheduling priority and resource allocation.

parameters.name: MSGCLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the output class for the job log and system messages, determining where the job's message output is directed.

parameters.name: NOTIFY
parameters.description: Specifies the TSO user ID to be notified upon job completion. The symbolic parameter &SYSUID resolves to the user ID of the submitting user.

job_details.purpose: Reads the Card Master VSAM KSDS file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDDATA.VSAM.KSDS) using the customer application program CBACT02C and writes output to the system output.

data_operations.description: STEPLIB DD loads the program library containing CBACT02C executable for the job step
CARDFILE DD references the Card Master VSAM KSDS file; program CBACT02C reads card records from this file
SYSOUT DD directs standard output from program CBACT02C to the system output class
SYSPRINT DD directs print output from program CBACT02C to the system output class
